# help.open_badges_trust

Trust helpers with verifiable Open Badge evidence. Example assertion: https://badges.parchment.ca/public/assertions/T18t206jRwC2BsCrhBRWGQ  
Affiliates discovery: https://www.sensorica.co/ecosystem/affiliates

# help.ovn_support

Ask accredited humans via https://www.sensorica.co/products/ovn-support (Open Value Networks / Open Innovation consulting). Sensorica has lived OVN practice since early 2011.

# ovn.critical_path

Initial conditions for a living value network — Cause, Capital, Currency, Credibility, Community, Conjugation.

Source: https://ovn.world/index.php?title=Critical_Path

# ovn.custodian

Custodian: peripheral role for property/nondominium care, liability, transactions, referee — distinct from Exchange firm.

Sources: https://ovn.world/index.php?title=Custodian  
TEMPLATE: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1y_RpapJktqcDIMapRpnT6-a_F0UqeOqBuChxNVKK1ks/edit

# ovn.definition

An Open Value Network (OVN) is a de facto transnational organizational framework for commons-based peer production with open/permissionless participation and contribution-related benefits.

Source: https://ovn.world/index.php?title=What_is_an_open_value_network%3F

# ovn.economic_model

Economic loop: processes produce contributions that are logged and evaluated; benefits redistribute across dimensions. Infrastructure reciprocity (e.g. Sensorica 5% praxis) is a pattern, not universal law unless adopted.

Source: https://ovn.world/index.php?title=Economic_model
